# Third-party marks

Not ours. Each file here belongs to the organisation it names, is used only to
refer to that organisation, and is never restyled, recoloured or redrawn.

| File | Whose | Where it came from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stellar-logo.svg` | Stellar Development Foundation | supplied by Nabil, 15 Sep 2026. 106x26, one fill, the current mark |

The Stellar mark appears once, in the Why Stellar section, to name the network
this protocol runs on. If SDF ever asks for a different treatment, or the brand
pack at [stellar.org/brand-resources](https://stellar.org/brand-resources)
supersedes this file, replace it here rather than editing the path data.
